news.headline: Opendoor Gains 5% but Is Still Down 24% in a Month. Will the Bulls or Bears Win?
news.summary: Opendoor stock cratered while the broader market climbed, and the obvious explanation collapses the moment you look at what its closest competitor actually did over the same stretch.

news.headline: Why Did NKE, OPEN, MCD Stocks Slip To 52-Week Lows Last Week?
news.summary: Nike, Opendoor Technologies and McDonald's shares all slumped to 52-week lows last week amid negative catalysts and growing Wall Street concerns.
